evals.prompt: Research the feature flag vendor landscape for a migration decision. I do not need an immediate answer; use the default /research workflow.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks BrainLayer first, launches the researcher subagent in the background, states where the report will land, and plans to digest useful findings for later retrieval.

assertions.name: checks-brainlayer-first
assertions.description: Response begins by checking existing BrainLayer knowledge before spending time on fresh research

assertions.name: uses-researcher-subagent-for-default-mode
assertions.description: Response routes standard research to the researcher subagent instead of doing everything inline

assertions.name: runs-research-in-background
assertions.description: Response treats default research as an asynchronous/background task rather than blocking for a long inline answer

assertions.name: plans-to-store-keepable-results
assertions.description: Response includes digesting or storing worthwhile results after reading the generated report

evals.prompt: Quick question: use /research --quick to compare Linear vs Height for a small product team and answer inline.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses inline web search/fetch in parallel, synthesizes a concise answer directly, and does not spin up a background report workflow.

assertions.name: uses-inline-web-research-for-quick-mode
assertions.description: Response chooses direct WebSearch/WebFetch style research instead of the researcher subagent

assertions.name: parallelizes-search-queries
assertions.description: Response reflects the quick-mode pattern of running several searches in parallel

assertions.name: returns-inline-without-report-file
assertions.description: Response answers in the current context rather than describing a saved report or long-running job

evals.prompt: Before I open a PR, use /research --audit on this diff summary: /Users/etanheyman/Gits/orchestrator/skill-evals/research/evals/fixtures/diff-summary.txt.
evals.expected_output: Agent routes the pre-PR audit to CLI research backends such as Gemini and Cursor in parallel, compares their findings, and uses that synthesis as extra review before the PR loop.

assertions.name: routes-audit-mode-to-cli-agents
assertions.description: Response uses the audit-specific CLI agent path rather than the generic researcher subagent

assertions.name: uses-multiple-audit-backends-in-parallel
assertions.description: Response invokes both Gemini and Cursor style audit backends in parallel for extra coverage

assertions.name: compares-findings-before-conclusion
assertions.description: Response synthesizes or cross-checks the multiple audit outputs instead of trusting a single backend
